prompts.prompt_verbatim:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: 16:9 campaign hero for an unofficial lifelong HBCU fan-community social presence
Primary request: an ultra-realistic, cinematic editorial photograph about generations of Black college pride that lasts for life
Scene/backdrop: outside a grand but unbranded Southern college football stadium at golden hour, stadium lights glowing through light atmospheric haze, subtle crowd energy in the distance
Subject: an intergenerational group of seven Black adults spanning current-student age through elders in their late sixties, walking together toward the stadium with confident joy; one older alumnus carries a worn ticket scrapbook, a current student carries a plain megaphone, a parent and adult child walk shoulder to shoulder; natural individuality and authentic age detail
Style/medium: premium ultra-realistic campaign photography, 35mm editorial lens, lifelike skin texture, natural hair detail, realistic fabric, cinematic but believable
Composition/framing: wide horizontal composition, group weighted toward the right two-thirds, generous darker negative space on the left for website typography, full and three-quarter figures, low heroic camera angle
Lighting/mood: warm sunset rim light, deep emerald shadows, copper-orange practical light, proud, affectionate, defiant, generational
Materials/textures: worn leather scrapbook, brushed metal railings, concrete stadium grain, subtle abstract iridescent scale reflections in the light—not a literal logo
Constraints: no text; no letters; no school name; no official university logo, seal, mascot, uniform, licensed mark, celebrity, real identifiable person, watermark, hazing, worship ritual, religious imagery, coercion, menace, or propaganda; portray healthy community, alumni continuity, mentorship, culture, game-day joy, and belonging
Avoid: generic stock-photo smiles, matching outfits, plastic skin, cloned faces, extra fingers, aggressive snake imagery

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: 4:5 original character-brand portrait for an unofficial lifelong college fan project
Primary request: create "THE LIFER," an entirely original ultra-realistic fantasy-realism serpent-spirit character symbolizing alumni pride that never fades
Scene/backdrop: an unbranded stadium tunnel opening toward warm game-day light, layered concrete, brass rails, atmospheric particles, faint abstract coil shadows
Subject: a dignified humanoid rattlesnake spirit with biologically convincing emerald, charcoal, and copper scale detail, expressive intelligent eyes, relaxed confident posture, warm knowing half-smile rather than aggression; wearing a high-fashion vintage varsity-inspired jacket made of deep forest wool, copper leather sleeves, cream piping, completely blank with no letters, numbers, logo, seal, or patches; tail naturally coiled beside one well-worn stadium seat and a blank vintage ticket
Style/medium: ultra-realistic cinematic creature portrait, luxury editorial character photography, convincing anatomy and materials, sophisticated Black cultural fashion influence without impersonating any person or copying an existing mascot
Composition/framing: vertical 4:5, full three-quarter character, strong silhouette, room above and beside the head for separate HTML typography, readable on a phone
Lighting/mood: dramatic tunnel rim light, emerald shadow, copper highlights, proud, witty, welcoming, timeless
Materials/textures: detailed natural scales, wool varsity texture, aged leather, stadium concrete, metallic ticket edge
Constraints: no text; no letters; no school name; no official mascot likeness, university logo, seal, wordmark, uniform, copyrighted character, celebrity, real person, watermark, forked tongue display, fangs, threat, violence, cult ritual, religious iconography, hazing, or coercion; this must read as an original unofficial fan character
Avoid: cartoon mascot, sports-team logo design, costume head, horror monster, generic dragon, official orange-and-green uniform
